**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target), confidence 0.72.**

What I found across the whole document:

- **Our exit right is fine.** Section 14 (p0079) gives Client an unconditional at-will termination right, effective the last day of the month following the notice month (~30–60 days), and no early-termination fee, penalty or unamortised-cost charge exists anywhere (Section 5 fees are invoiced monthly and paid in arrears; p0045, p0047). Fallback elements 1 and 2 are met or bettered. The preferred extras — a flat 30-day notice and an express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees — are short, but immaterial here since nothing is prepaid; noted in the rationale, not redlined.
- **TrueLink cannot walk mid-term**, but Section 13 (p0078) auto-renews for successive one-year terms and allows *either* party to block renewal on only **thirty (30) days'** notice. A Vendor convenience exit on fewer than 90 days' notice is walk-away territory under the rule, so the fallback fails on a material term.
- Checked every other location for hidden exit or penalty language (licence term p0028, Sections 3/4 service commitments, Sections 7–11, survival p0090); no other termination-for-convenience or fee-on-exit provision exists.

**Single surgical edit (validated ok:true):** in p0078, split the mutual non-renewal notice so Client keeps 30 days while TrueLink must give ninety (90) days, leaving its exit confined to the end of a term and all other text intact.
